title: Case archive at 1.0 mm (4 cases, ~34 MB) in real Chrome after PR 66 (archive performance) and PR 73 (connector immediate re-poll)

environment.base: worktree p-d merged origin/main at 0506290 (PR 66 and PR 73 included)
environment.browser: real Chrome (Claude in Chrome), own tab, vite dev on 127.0.0.1:5174, stdio connector with a file-IPC driver
environment.case: axial bar reference demo, mesh size 1.0 mm, ~8.5 MB archived per case
environment.machineLoad: Not controlled. Other agents shared the machine; the Windows CPU counter read 100 percent at times while per-process deltas were low. The tab was a background tab. Over a long session the tab became sluggish: after the 5th/6th save in one run the renderer froze for minutes, a fresh tab once needed about 130 s to mesh and solve the 1.0 mm case (about 40 s normally), and a 4th save needed several attempts in another run. Numbers below are from the final clean run unless stated.
environment.harnessLatency: Per-command latency is dominated by the connector idle poll (about 1.0 s per call: minimum chunk 952 ms, median about 1000 ms), not by payload. Driver file-IPC polling was reduced to about 20 ms for the final runs, so about 1.0 s is the connector poll floor for sequential external commands. The same floor was present in the earlier numbers.

saveMs: 4th timed out twice at 15 s, succeeded on 3rd attempt (14268 ms)

fifthAndSixthSave.note: completed under the 15 s limit but close to it

both hit the 15 s command timeout; later caseList calls took 90-100 s and the tab froze for several minutes; the 4-case export read in that run failed at chunk 494 of 518 with a command timeout after chunk times rose from about 1 s to 4-9 s in the last ~25 chunks (first quarter avg 1005 ms, last quarter 1503 ms)

earlierTwoCaseRun.note: before the driver polling was sped up; chunk times flat about 1.0 s; saves 3 and 4 timed out in that run

comparison: Read total 518.5 s vs 519.2 s before (unchanged). Import write 518.0 s vs 1154 s before (2.2x faster) with flat per-chunk time (first quarter 1000 ms, last quarter 1000 ms) instead of growing 1 s to 3-4 s. The 5th and 6th caseSave completed (10.9 s and 13.6 s) in the final run, where previously the 5th timed out; in another run both again hit the 15 s timeout, so the margin is thin and varies with machine and tab state. Building four cases: saves 2.8, 4.3, 5.9, 8.2 s; caseList grew 1.4 to 5.0 s.

checks.detail: 518 chunks, assembled SHA-256 equals declared; read per chunk flat about 1.0 s
import into an emptied case list committed; archiveRevision and all four case revisions equal those before export; case count 4
2 small cases round-tripped with equal archive and case revisions
caseSave 5 and 6 under 15 s in the final run, over it in an earlier run; the 4th save timed out in one loaded run

notVerified: Whether the improved per-chunk import time holds on an unloaded machine or foreground tab (per-chunk time is bounded below by the ~1 s connector idle poll in this harness)
Peak JS heap and memory (not measured; one tab froze for minutes with 6 cases held and renderers near 2 GB working set)
Cause of the 90-100 s caseList stalls and the tab freeze after the 5th/6th save in run 2 (page busy or memory pressure suspected, not diagnosed)
Run-to-run variance (only one fully clean 4-case read plus import was captured)
